questions.skill: Zener current range for varying input
questions.md: In a voltage regulator using Zener diode, the output voltage $V_0 = 5\,V$, input voltage $V_i = (12 \pm 3)\,V$, $R_S = 1\,k\Omega$, load current $I_L = 20\,mA$. Find the minimum and maximum currents flowing through the Zener diode.

Determine the range of input voltage to obtain an output voltage of $6.3\,V$ in a Zener voltage regulator circuit. The current flowing through the Zener diode ranges from $2\,mA$ to $28\,mA$ and the load resistance is $1\,k\Omega$. Assume $R_s = 470\,\Omega$. Draw the circuit diagram.

questions.skill: Zener load resistance and current range
questions.md: For a Zener network, $R_S = 500\,\Omega$, $V_Z = 12\,V$ and $V_i = 50\,V$. Determine the minimum and maximum values of $R_L$ and load current so that the Zener diode remains in ON state and safe, given that $I_{Z\min} = 2\,mA$ and $P_{Z\max} = 500\,mW$. Draw the circuit diagram for the same.

questions.skill: Diode resistance and saturation current vs temperature
questions.md: A PN-junction germanium diode has a saturation current of $1\,\mu A$ for an applied forward voltage of $0.2\,V$ at $27^\circ C$. Determine the static and dynamic resistance. Also calculate the reverse saturation current when temperature rises to $47^\circ C$.

questions.skill: Diode dynamic resistance at new temperature
